text: 埃及投资和外贸部长穆罕默德·法里德·萨利赫24日在开罗举行的记者会上表示，埃及欢迎中国企业赴埃投资，期待双方在海水淡化、人工智能、数字化服务等领域进一步拓展合作。萨利赫高度评价中国企业在埃及的发展表现。他表示，中国企业进入一些埃及尚未涉足的产业领域，为该国工业发展作出积极贡献。（新华社）
text_en: Egyptian Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade Mohamed Farid Saleh said at a press conference held in Cairo on the 24th that Egypt welcomes Chinese enterprises to invest in Egypt and looks forward to further expanding cooperation between the two sides in areas such as seawater desalination, artificial intelligence and digital services. Saleh spoke highly of the performance of Chinese enterprises in Egypt. He said Chinese enterprises have entered some industrial sectors not yet covered in Egypt and have made positive contributions to the country's industrial development. (Xinhua News Agency)
